## Summary

Northwind Data builds modern data infrastructure for financial services and insurance clients
who cannot afford data quality failures. We are a synthetic JD fixture used to test the resume
pipeline against the Greenhouse portal shape. Do not treat as a real role.

We are hiring a Senior Data Engineer to join our core data platform team in New York. You
will own the pipelines, transformations, and orchestration systems that power customer-facing
analytics and internal reporting. The role is hybrid — we expect two to three days per week
in our Manhattan office.

## Responsibilities

- Design and maintain data pipelines ingesting from diverse source systems into Snowflake
- Author and review dbt models that serve as the semantic layer for BI and data science use
- Build and operate Airflow DAGs with a focus on reliability, idempotency, and observability
- Partner with analytics engineers and data scientists to model domains correctly from the start
- Define and enforce data quality contracts including schema validation and freshness SLAs
- Drive incident response for pipeline failures and contribute to runbooks and postmortems
- Contribute to platform improvements including cost attribution, resource governance, and tooling

## Required Skills

- 4+ years of data engineering in a production setting with end-to-end pipeline ownership
- Expert-level Snowflake including warehouse sizing, clustering keys, and cost management
- Strong dbt experience including advanced features such as incremental models and snapshots
- Proficiency with Apache Airflow including custom operators, sensors, and dynamic task mapping
- Solid Python skills for data pipeline scripting, tooling, and data quality automation
- Experience with PySpark or similar distributed compute frameworks for large-scale transforms
- Familiarity with data modeling methodologies such as dimensional, data vault, or OBT patterns
- Strong SQL including window functions, CTEs, and query performance debugging
- Clear written communication for documenting systems, schemas, and incident timelines

## Preferred

- Experience in financial services, fintech, or regulated data environments with audit requirements
- Familiarity with data observability tooling such as Monte Carlo, Soda, or Great Expectations
- Background working with streaming data using Kafka, Flink, or Kinesis alongside batch pipelines
- Exposure to infrastructure-as-code tooling for managing Snowflake or Airflow environments

## Compensation

$170,000 – $230,000 base salary + annual bonus + equity + benefits

We offer full medical, dental, and vision coverage, 401(k) with employer match, commuter
benefits for NYC office days, and a generous professional development budget. Relocation
assistance is available for candidates moving to New York.

## About Northwind Data

Northwind Data was founded by data engineers who spent years watching financial institutions
lose millions to preventable data quality failures. We build the tooling and processes that
make data reliable by default, not as an afterthought.

Our clients trust us with mission-critical pipelines that feed regulatory reporting, risk
models, and customer-facing dashboards. We take that trust seriously and hire engineers who
share our obsession with correctness and operational discipline.

We are a Series A company with strong revenue and a deliberate growth pace. You will work with
a small, experienced data team and have direct access to customers and stakeholders. Decisions
are made by the people closest to the problem, not by committee.

Northwind Data is committed to equal employment opportunities. We welcome applicants from all
backgrounds and actively work to maintain an inclusive and respectful workplace.

## Interview Process

1. Recruiter intro — 30-minute call to discuss the role, team, and your background
2. Technical screen — 45-minute call with a senior data engineer covering SQL and dbt concepts
3. Take-home project — design and document a small data pipeline (3-hour time box)
4. Technical deep-dive — 90-minute review of the take-home plus a data modeling discussion
5. Stakeholder round — 30-minute call with an analytics or product stakeholder

Candidates for hybrid NYC roles are asked to visit the office for the final round when
possible. Remote participation is available for candidates outside the metro area during
the process. We aim to complete all rounds within three weeks and provide written feedback
after every stage.
